issues: Initial IR timestamp mismatch was recorded and now rejected with counters, not mislabeled as a valid stereo pair.
Initial wrapper falsely treated a missing Windows Process.ExitCode as failure; now checks the written result.

Camera LOST fractions vary significantly with current close scene; no controlled movement/fixed acceptance here.
L2 native clock ratio remains about 2; no LIO/deskew/fusion claim.
Main static lidar odometry failures and BeautyMap original boundary failure remain preserved.
configuration_format_note: RViz configs were normalized from CRLF to LF after GUI tests; property values unchanged. Session code-hashes retain actual bytes used at startup.
